hours_above_month_max.description: Reject a row whose Hours is above the maximum for its production month (D-010, DEC-030). days_x_24: days in month x 24. local_clock_hours: hours between local midnight on the 1st of the month and of the next month in the time zone (721 in a month where daylight saving time ends, 743 where it starts). max_of_calendar_and_clock: the larger of the two, so both reporting habits pass.
